description: Round 9's own verdict (FIND-017 evidence, verification_readiness dimension) explicitly claimed that adding a state.json entry for PROP-307e 'also resolves the ambiguity between the Deferred-obligation disposition section's literal "25+5, PLUS the new PROP-307e" enumeration (implying 31 total) and CRIT-205's own "30 targeted PROP IDs (including PROP-307e)" wording (implying 30, PROP-307e counted within)'. This claim is FALSE: the round-9 fix (verified this round, see FIND-017 in this round's verdict) only added state.json's PROP-121/BEAD-154 tracking entry -- it did not touch contracts/sprint-2.md's own prose at all, and the two contradictory phrasings remain byte-for-byte unchanged in the current document. CRIT-205 (lines 43, 45) still reads 'Every one of the 30 non-Tier-3 obligations this sprint targets' and 'For each of the 30 targeted PROP IDs (including PROP-307e)' -- explicitly asserting PROP-307e is ONE OF the 30, i.e. the total targeted count is 30. The 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section (lines 176-184) still reads: '**30 targeted for closure this sprint** (25 orchestrator-blocked Tier>0 + 5 Tier-0...)' followed by an explicit enumeration of exactly 25 Tier>0 PROP IDs + 5 Tier-0 PROP IDs (=30, matching the heading), and THEN, separately, appends '(5 Tier-0), PLUS the new PROP-307e (run.sh's real wake-cycle wiring, resolves FIND-004)' -- grammatically presenting PROP-307e as a 31st item ADDITIONAL to the already-fully-accounted-for 30, not one of the 30. These two framings ('including' = within the 30 vs 'PLUS' = additional to the 30) are mutually exclusive and both cannot be true simultaneously: either the sprint targets 30 total obligations (and PROP-307e is one of the enumerated 25+5, meaning the 25/5 sub-counts or the explicit PROP-ID list must be revised to visibly include it -- e.g. relabeled '26 orchestrator-blocked Tier>0' since PROP-307e is tier 1 per both state.json and verification-architecture.md's own PROP table), or the sprint targets 31 total (30 inherited-from-sprint-1 + 1 wholly new-this-sprint PROP-307e, which was never part of sprint-1's original 38-deferred-obligation reconciliation this section's own heading is titled after), and CRIT-205's 'the 30... (including PROP-307e)' phrasing needs to become 'the 31...' or 'the 30 sprint-1-deferred obligations plus PROP-307e'. Root-cause note: PROP-307e genuinely is NOT one of sprint-1's original 38 deferred obligations (it did not exist until sprint-2's own round-2 fix, since REQ-307 itself is new this sprint) -- so the 'PLUS' framing is the substantively correct one, and CRIT-205's 'including' framing is the one that needs the edit. This is a textual/prose defect, not a bookkeeping-entry defect, and is therefore not fixed by round 9's state.json edit no matter how thorough that edit was.

evidence.filePath: contracts/sprint-2.md (CRIT-205, lines 43/45) vs. Deferred-obligation disposition, lines 176-184, 'PLUS the new PROP-307e'
evidence.snippet: Line 43: 'Every one of the 30 non-Tier-3 obligations this sprint targets'. Line 45: 'For each of the 30 targeted PROP IDs (including PROP-307e)...'. Line 176: '**30 targeted for closure this sprint** (25 orchestrator-blocked Tier>0 + 5 Tier-0...)'. Lines 180-184 enumerate exactly 25 Tier>0 PROP IDs + 5 Tier-0 PROP IDs (independently counted this session: 25 and 5, total 30, matching the heading exactly with ZERO slots left for PROP-307e), then append: '(5 Tier-0), PLUS the new PROP-307e (run.sh's real wake-cycle wiring, resolves FIND-004).' -- confirming PROP-307e is presented as a 31st, additional item, not folded into the already-complete 25+5=30 enumeration. Cross-referenced against reviews/contracts/sprint-2-r9/output/verdict.json's own FIND-017 evidence text, which asserts (incorrectly) that the state.json fix 'also resolves' this exact ambiguity -- re-reading the current contracts/sprint-2.md this round confirms neither sentence was edited.
